name: Talion, the Kindly Lord
oracle_text:
Flying
As Talion enters, choose a number between 1 and 10.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value, power, or toughness equal to the chosen number, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.
blocked_sentences: As Talion enters, choose a number between 1 and 10.
Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value, power, or toughness equal to the chosen number, that player loses 2 life and you draw a card.

needs.what: an "as this permanent enters, choose a number between N and M" replacement that stores the number on the permanent for as long as it stays on the battlefield (like the existing per-permanent chosen_color / chosen_type), plus a value/filter leaf such as {"chosen_number_of": "self"} that a spell_cast trigger filter can compare a spell's mana_value, power and toughness against (any_of over the three)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The choose_number op binds its result with 'as' only for the duration of the one resolving effect, so a later spell_cast trigger cannot read it; it is also an op, not an as-enters replacement, so writing it on a self_enters trigger would make the choice a trigger that can be responded to. chosen_color_of / chosen_type_of persist on the permanent but there is no numeric counterpart, and trigger_filter_keys mana_value/power/toughness take only fixed comparisons
